titulo: Delta Air Lines, Apr 2026: federal lobbying reports for 2025, about 59.1 years of the median employee's annual pay. The math.
caption:
Delta Air Lines, Apr 2026: federal lobbying reports for 2025, about 59.1 years of the median employee's annual pay. The math.

Delta filed four LD-2 federal lobbying reports for 2025 and, in its 2026 proxy statement, reported its median employee's 2025 pay.

From the archive: Apr 2026. Not today's news.

The math: $5,970,000 (federal lobbying expenses, 2025; sum of four quarterly LD-2 reports) ÷ $100,976 (median employee's annual total compensation, 2025) = about 59.1 years of the median employee's annual pay. We round down.
Lobbying is legal and disclosed. Each report gives one amount for its quarter.

(Our take.) The people are the foundation. Here is the lobbying column.

Sources
F1: Delta Air Lines proxy statement (DEF 14A), 2026, filed Apr 24, 2026 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/27904/000130817926000345/dal014970-def14a.htm
F2: Delta Air Lines LD-2 quarterly reports, filing year 2025, filed Apr 21, 2025 to Jan 20, 2026 · https://lda.gov/api/v1/filings/?registrant_name=Delta+Air+Lines&filing_year=2025

The quotes on screen are copied from the filings. Original music. No narration.
